mechanics.claim: Light Binding hits the first two enemies hit by the skillshot, each taking damage as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first two enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: Targets immune to the root still count towards the two-target limit, implying each hit target is registered independently for damage purposes.
mechanics.quote: Targets immune to the {{tip|root}} still count towards ''Light Binding's'' two-target limit.

mechanics.claim: Light Binding spawns an additional dummy missile with the same visual effects, but it does not deal separate damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Light Binding'' spawns an additional missile at the same location and vector as the main missile.
